title: ComponentReference
description: A composition declaration attached to a parent component that names one of the parent's slots and identifies, by specNodeId, the library component or component instance to be rendered into that slot. It records the slot-filling relationship only; it carries no prop values of its own beyond an optional variant override and is not itself a rendered occurrence. Use ComponentInstance instead when the element is a concrete, configured usage of a library component with its own props and render order inside a View or SubView, rather than a pointer filling a parent's named slot. Use LibraryComponent instead when the element defines a reusable component's props, slots and events schema, rather than declaring what fills one slot of a parent. Use SubView instead when the embedded content is a grouping of several components placed in a View's subViews list, not a single component placed into a named slot of a parent component.

ref.description: SpecNodeId of the component (ux.librarycomponent or ux.componentinstance) to render in the slot.

variant.description: Optional design variant override for this reference (e.g., 'compact', 'expanded', 'readonly'). Must match a variant defined on the referenced component.

slot.description: Named slot in the parent component where this reference is placed. Slot names are defined by the parent LibraryComponent (e.g., 'header', 'actions', 'footer').

x-dr-standard: HTML 5.3 §4.12.8 The slot element (Web Components named slots)
x-dr-evidence: A child element carrying a slot="header"/slot="actions" attribute, a Vue <template #footer> / v-slot directive, or an Angular <ng-content select=...> projection target being filled.
A React prop typed as ReactNode or render-prop (e.g. header={<Toolbar/>}, actions={<Button variant="compact"/>}) passed to a layout or container component.
A Storybook or design-system doc listing a component's slots together with the allowed child components for each slot (e.g. 'Card.footer accepts Button | Link').
